description:
Screen a company's posture against applicable regulations.

    Returns compliance level, percentage, gaps, and remediation priorities.
    Gated obligations count only when their applicability is established from
    inputs. California SB 253 needs revenue over $1B in each of the two
    previous fiscal years (`annual_revenue_usd` = most recent year,
    `prior_year_revenue_usd` = the year before) and an `entity_profile` with
    entity_form (corporation|partnership|llc|other_business_entity),
    formed_under_us_law, does_business_in_california and exemption
    (none|tax_exempt_nonprofit|insurance|government_majority_owned|
    wholesale_electricity_only|payroll_only). Missing inputs list it under
    applicability_unconfirmed and the level is "undetermined", never
    "compliant". Screening only, not legal advice.

annual_revenue_usd.description: Optional. Latest annual revenue in US dollars, for scope tests.
annual_revenue_usd.title: Annual Revenue Usd

disclosures.description: Optional. Disclosures the company already makes, for example ["CSRD"].
disclosures.title: Disclosures

entity_profile.description: Optional. Facts for applicability tests, for example employees or listing.
entity_profile.title: Entity Profile

jurisdiction.description: Where the company operates, for example california, us, eu or uk.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

payment_ref.description: Optional. A paid credit or payment reference, used only after the free daily calls. Leave it out to use the free tier or a seat.
payment_ref.title: Payment Ref

prior_year_revenue_usd.description: Optional. Prior year's revenue in US dollars.
prior_year_revenue_usd.title: Prior Year Revenue Usd

request_id.description: Optional. Your id for this call. Repeat it to retry safely: the same request_id is never charged twice.
request_id.title: Request Id

sector.description: Industry, for example energy or manufacturing.
sector.title: Sector

name: assess_compliance
title: Assess compliance
